title: Capacity used, available and at risk
description: Exact used and available proportions against an explicit capacity. An optional warning threshold classifies usage, with the measured values beside the ring.

props.name: data
props.description: An explicit used value and capacity. Capacity must be finite and positive; used must be finite and between zero and capacity. Unknown or out-of-range input renders an unavailable state.

props.name: unitLabel
props.description: Unit for the numeric capacity values; defaults to units.

props.name: warningAt
props.description: Optional warning threshold as a fraction from zero to one. Usage below it is within threshold, usage at or above it is a warning, and full capacity is critical. Omission leaves usage neutral.

props.name: label
props.description: Console header label; the surrounding gallery or application owns its page title.

props.name: source
props.description: Caller-supplied source text in the footer.

props.name: window
props.description: Caller-supplied aggregation window or snapshot context in the footer.

props.name: updated
props.description: Caller-supplied freshness text; the component never invents live status.

props.name: width
props.description: Optional total width in pixels; otherwise fills the container.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total height in pixels. Dense plot content scrolls locally when constrained.

props.name: animate
props.description: Finite entrance animation using scoped motion tokens and the current reduced-motion preference.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional Tailwind utilities for the outer frame.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible description of this chart instance.
